name: XposedOrNot (breach names per e-mail, breach analytics, breach catalogue, own-domain breaches)
tier_rationale: Well-known open-source community project with public API documentation, published terms and more than two years of public track record (A8 community); P137 chair: 'XposedOrNot is a community project: tier community'.

reliability.justification: Community project re-serving public breach corpora: breach ids join its own catalogue (dates, data classes, verified/sensitive flags); some entries are unverified or combolists, and generic addresses list hundreds of breaches (test@example.com -> 216).

error_markers.reason: XposedOrNot: keyless limit reached (2/s, 25/h, 100/day per IP): could not verify - a xonAPI+ key lifts it
XposedOrNot: keyless limit reached (HTTP 429; 2/s, 25/h, 100/day per IP): could not verify - a xonAPI+ key lifts it

xon.description: XposedOrNot API key (x-api-key header): domain-breaches for the account's verified own domains; xonAPI+/xonEnterprise+ plans for business use
xon.plan_hint: an account created under the corporate identity with the organisation's domains verified (DNS/HTML/e-mail); business use needs a paid plan (xonEnterprise+ for own-domain monitoring, xonAPI+ for API workloads): record it with key_plans.xon = 'business' (P137 cond 1)

api.title: XposedOrNot keyless API: GET /v1/check-email/{email} (breach ids) and GET /v1/breach-analytics?email= (per-breach metadata, risk, paste count)

terms.quote: Commercial use of our data requires a proper licensing agreement

sanitizer.notes: P137 cond 5 / P145: breach ids, per-breach metadata (domain, industry, year, records, data classes, password FORM, verified/searchable, added), the risk label/score, year counts and the paste COUNT survive before the HTTP cache. Logos, descriptions, reference URLs, paste lists, password-strength statistics and any future field are dropped; password_risk is kept only as the normalised password_form (core form renaming).

api.notes: A1 initial class: XposedOrNot keyless = 'noncommercial' (P137 cond 1, quote verified 2026-11-26): off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared; keyless use only through licence_allow or the research profile. Limits 2 req/s, 25/hour, 100/day per egress IP (quota block; P137 cond 4). A never-seen address answers HTTP 200 {'Error': 'Not found', 'email': null} (live 2026-11-26; the research saw a 404): both are the declared absence 'not found in XposedOrNot'. The address is lower-cased and URL-encoded (P137 cond 2). Research C0306 (verified_live 200). Used by xposedornot.
api.licensed_alternative: xonAPI+ (key-terms, business plan from US$9/month, P137 cond 1) or the company-paid HIBP subscription (hibp.account).

catalogue.title: XposedOrNot breach catalogue GET /v1/breaches (~645 KB, daily dataset xposedornot_breaches.json; a ?domain= answer means 'this service was breached')

terms.quote: Commercial use of our data requires a proper licensing agreement

sanitizer.notes: P137 cond 5 / P145: catalogue metadata only. Logos (external images, never loaded), exposure descriptions and reference URLs are dropped before the dataset copy is stored; passwordRisk survives only as the normalised password_form.

catalogue.notes: Same terms as the keyless API (P137 cond 1). Downloaded once a day as a registered dataset and joined offline (P137 cond 2): ids from check-email get dates, data classes and the sensitive flag; sensitive breaches are masked by default (P137 cond 5). A domain lookup in the catalogue means 'this service was breached', never 'accounts at this domain'. Research C0307 (verified_live 200, 801 entries). Used by xposedornot and xposedornot_domain.

domain_breaches.title: XposedOrNot POST /v1/domain-breaches/ with x-api-key: breached addresses of the account's verified own domains (run_on own_assets_only)

terms.quote: xonEnterprise+ From $25/mo Monitor your domains, get alerted when staff credentials leak.

sanitizer.notes: P137 cond 2 / P145: per exposed own-domain address only the domain, the address and the breach name survive before the HTTP cache (the answer lists employees' addresses: access restricted to the case); every other field is dropped.

domain_breaches.notes: P137 cond 2: only with key 'xon' for txt_verified/attested own domains (run_on own_assets_only, A11 BR4), because it returns employees' e-mails. Key-terms: under the corporate profile it runs only with key_plans.xon = 'business' (xonEnterprise+ for own-domain monitoring, P137 cond 1). 401 {'detail': 'Invalid or missing API key'} = NEEDS_KEY (P137 cond 8). Research C0314 (verified_needs_key 401); the success schema follows the XposedOrNot API documentation and is to be re-captured with the team key. Used by xposedornot_domain_breaches.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G04-1 (P137 xposedornot, xposedornot_domain, xposedornot_domain_breaches). Sensitive provider (A4/P137 cond 5): every source has an allow-list sanitizer applied before the HTTP cache (TTL <= 7 days); metadata only; logos are never loaded. personal_data_review must be recorded before default use (P137 cond 6).
